title: Return a calculated value
summary: Fortran: Return a calculated value. Call twice(7).
introduction: A function has a result. contains separates the main steps from local function definitions.
learningObjectives: Return a calculated value with Fortran

blocks.text: Install GNU Fortran. Save each example as lesson.f90, run gfortran -std=f2008 lesson.f90 -o lesson, then run it.

blocks.title: Return a calculated value
blocks.code:
program lesson
 implicit none
 write(*,'(I0)') twice(4)
contains
 integer function twice(n) result(answer)
  integer, intent(in) :: n
  answer = n * 2
 end function twice
end program lesson

blocks.text: twice takes input 4. Its result variable receives 8.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Give the function input and result explicit types.
